pidimos: pedir — we ask, request (present 1st pl., with i for e; merced vos pidimos 'we ask a grace of you'; = pedimos)
demandedes: demandar — (that) you ask for, request (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -edes ending; que nos demandedes fijas 'that you ask for (his) daughters for us', nos the dative of interest; = demandéis, pidáis)
comidió: comedir — he reflected, pondered (preterite 3rd sg.; penssó e comidió 'he thought and pondered', Pidal 'pensó y meditó'; = meditó)
eché: echar — I cast out, banished (preterite 1st sg.; = eché)
faziendo: fazer — doing (gerund; faziendo yo a él mal 'I doing him harm', a gerund clause with its own subject; = haciendo)
casamiento: casamiento — marriage, match, wedding alliance (= casamiento)
bos: vos — you (spelling variant with b for v; here subject, bos lo queredes 'you wish it')
entremos: entrar — let us enter (present subjunctive 1st pl., hortatory; entrar en la razón 'to take up the matter'; = entremos)
llamó: llamar — he called, summoned (preterite 3rd sg.; = llamó)
quadra: quadra — chamber, private room (= cuadra, here a side room of the palace)
apartó: apartar — he drew aside (preterite 3rd sg.; los apartó 'he took them apart'; = apartó)
sírvem: servir + me — serves me (present 3rd sg. sirve + enclitic me, dative; mio Çid is the subject: sírvem mio Çid 'my Cid serves me'; = me sirve)
roi: Roy — Ruy, short for Rodrigo (spelling variant of Roy; Roi Díaz = Rodrigo Díaz, the Cid)
viniéssem: venir + me — let him come to me (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg. viniesse + enclitic me reduced to -m, a wish; viniéssem a vistas, Pidal 'venga a vistas conmigo'; = me viniese, viniese a mí)
vistas: vistas — meeting, interview of persons (fem. pl. noun; a vistas 'to a meeting'; = vistas, entrevista)
didago: Didago — Diego (Diego González, one of the two infantes of Carrión; = Diego)
ferrando: Ferrando — Fernando (Fernando González, the other infante of Carrión; = Fernando)
ruégovoslo: rogar + vos + lo — I ask it of you (present 1st sg. ruego + enclitics vos, lo; = os lo ruego)
creçrá: creçer — he will grow, increase (future 3rd sg. with the e dropped; creçrá en onor 'he will grow in estate and lordship'; = crecerá)
onor: onor — estate, lordship: the lands and rank held of a lord (fem.; creçer en onor 'to grow in lands and lordship'; tollida la onor 'the estate taken away'; = honor in its old sense, heredad, señorío; distinct from ondra 'honour')
conssagrar: conssagrar — to become kin by marriage, as father-in-law to son-in-law or the reverse (infinitive; por conssagrar con iffantes 'by becoming kin to the infantes'; Pidal 'emparentar con relación de suegro a yerno'; = emparentar)
dezides: dezir — you say (present 2nd pl., old -des ending; = decís)
oviere: aver — he shall have (future subjunctive 3rd sg.; lo que oviere sabor 'whatever he may wish'; = hubiere)
dixiere: dezir — he shall say (future subjunctive 3rd sg.; do elle dixiere 'wherever he names'; = dijere)
mojón: mojón — boundary marker, landmark (= mojón, here the marker fixing the meeting-place)
espidiensse: espedir + se — they took (were taking) their leave (imperfect 3rd pl. espidien, -ien = -ían, + enclitic se; espidiensse al rey 'they took leave of the king'; = se despedían)
reçebirlos: reçebir + los — to receive them (infinitive + enclitic los; = recibirlos)
reçibió: reçebir — he received, accepted (preterite 3rd sg.; = recibió)
davos: dar + vos — he gives you (present 3rd sg. da + enclitic vos; = os da)
conpieçan: conpeçar — they begin (present 3rd pl.; conpieçan la razón 'they begin the talk'; = comienzan, empiezan)
león: León — León, the kingdom and city (Alfons el de León 'Alfonso of León'; = León)
connosçie: connosçer — he recognized, acknowledged (imperfect 3rd sg. in -ie; quel connosçie i ondra 'that he saw honour in it for him'; = conocía, reconocía)
creçrié: creçer — he would grow (conditional 3rd sg., syncopated, -ié ending; = crecería)
conssejava: conssejar — he was advising (imperfect 3rd sg.; = aconsejaba)
cristus: Cristus — Christ (nominative form in -us, Latin Christus; = Cristo)
fu: seer — I was (preterite 1st sg. fu; echado fu 'I was cast out'; = fui)
tollida: toller — taken away (past participle fem. sg., agreeing with onor; = quitada)
pidenme: pedir + me — they ask me (present 3rd pl. piden + enclitic me; = me piden)
natura: natura — birth, lineage (de grand natura 'of high birth'; = linaje, naturaleza)
çasamiento: casamiento — marriage, match (spelling variant with ç; = casamiento)
avría: aver — I would have (conditional 1st sg., syncopated; non avría sabor 'I would take no pleasure'; = habría)
fablemos: fablar — let us speak (present subjunctive 1st pl., hortatory; = hablemos)
seamos: seer — let us be (present subjunctive 1st pl.; = seamos)
afé: afé — behold, here is (presentative particle, used before a noun; afé Dios del çielo 'behold God of heaven'; = he aquí; origin uncertain)
acuerde: acordar — may he bring to agreement, guide (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; que nos acuerde en lo mijor 'that he bring us to agree on the best'; = acuerde)
vernié: venir — he would come (conditional 3rd sg. in -ié, with n and r changing places: venrié > vernié; = vendría)
oviéssedes: aver — you might have (imperfect subjunctive 2nd pl., old -des ending; do oviéssedes sabor 'where you might wish'; = hubieseis)
ye: aver — conditional auxiliary after an infinitive, 3rd sg. (ye = ie, imperfect of aver; querer vos ye 'he would want to see you'; = ía)
yedes: aver — conditional auxiliary after an infinitive, 2nd pl. (yedes = iedes; acordar vos yedes 'you would agree'; = íais)
sabidor: sabidor — one who knows, informed, in charge (= sabedor; vos seed sabidor 'you be the judge, the one who decides')
quisiesse: querer — he might wish (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg.; = quisiese)
fallássemos: fallar — we might find (imperfect subjunctive 1st pl.; = halláramos, hallásemos)
iriemos: ir — we would go (conditional 1st pl., -iemos ending; buscar lo iriemos 'we would go and seek him'; = iríamos)
darle: dar + le — to give him (infinitive + enclitic le; = darle)
ayamos: aver — let us have (present subjunctive 1st pl.; ayamos vistas 'let us hold a meeting'; = hayamos)
escrivien: escrivir — they were writing (imperfect 3rd pl., -ien ending; = escribían)

__broaden__.casar: casar — to marry off, to be married (infinitive; por casar son vuestras fijas 'your daughters are to be married'; por + inf. 'still to be done'; = casar) · also casar — to marry (infinitive, active, of the suitors; casar queremos con ellas 'we wish to marry them'; = casar)
__broaden__.penssó: pensar — he set about (preterite 3rd sg.; pensar de + inf. 'to set about doing'; = pensó) · also pensar — he thought, considered (preterite 3rd sg.; penssó e comidió 'he thought and pondered'; = pensó)
__broaden__.amor: amor — love; por amor de 'for the love of' · also amor — favour, grace of a lord toward his vassal (davos su amor 'he gives you his favour'; del rey he su amor 'I have the king's favour')
__broaden__.rogar: rogar — to pray (infinitive; ayude a rogar 'help (me) to pray'; = rogar) · also rogar — to ask, beg (a request made to a person; rogar gelo emos 'we will ask it of him'; = rogar, pedir)
__broaden__.rogava: rogar — he prayed (imperfect) · also rogar — he was asking, requesting (lo quel rogava 'what he was asking of him'; = rogaba, pedía)
__broaden__.andar: andar — to travel, go on (infinitive; = andar) · also andar a alguien — to act for someone, stand by him (andar le quiero a mio Çid en toda pro, Pidal 'quiero ayudar al Cid en cuanto pueda')
__broaden__.conssejo: conssejo — help, remedy (spelling variant of consejo; Pidal 'amparo, socorro'; = consejo) · also conssejo — council, deliberation (fablando en so conssejo 'talking in their council'; = consejo) · also conssejo — counsel, advice (con vuestro conssejo 'with your counsel'; = consejo)
__broaden__.tornados: tornar — turned back, returned (past part. masc. pl., agreeing with los 'them'; a los moros dentro los an tornados 'they have put the Moors back inside'; = vueltos, devueltos) · also tornar — turned back, returned (intransitive, with ser; tornados son 'they have turned back'; = vueltos)
__broaden__.agua: agua — water · also agua — river (una agua mayor 'a great river'; = río)
__broaden__.ora: hora — hour (= hora); en buen ora, part of the poem's honorific birth-formula, 'born in a good hour' · al ora 'at that very hour, then' (en ti crovo al ora) · also una grant ora — a long while (Pidal 'un gran rato'; = un buen rato)
__broaden__.sis: si + se — if … themselves (conjunction si + reflexive se; que sis pudiessen ir 'that if they could go away'; = si se) · also si + se — whether … (si 'whether' with se of interest; non sé sis abrá sabor 'I do not know whether he will like it')
